h_definitions.h_usage_count: K nonnegative integer counts of successful commits controlled by each H; never used=0, available
h_definitions.h_recent_usage_count: K integer counts in the same last min(10,t) GLOBAL commits; zero available; also sample counts for h_recent_delta_mean
h_definitions.h_last_use_gap_fraction: K values (t-last_commit_index[h])/D in [0,1); last step=0; never used=None, item unavailable
h_definitions.h_recent_delta_mean: K means of actual normalized deltas controlled by H in the GLOBAL ten-commit window, [0,1]; no recent sample=None, item unavailable; real zero available

spec.member_order: one immutable K-vector per field, in the frozen problem-specific H order
spec.availability: base fields use bool masks; H fields use K bool masks under availability[field][literal_H_index]
spec.history_scope: reset for each instance and each candidate solve; only real successful commits
spec.timing: observe before U; only selected H scores; commit action; then update selected-H history
spec.delta_scales: unchanged v2: FJSP partial makespan/Pmax; TSP chosen edge/dmax excluding closure; OBP new bins 0/1
spec.missing: counts always available; gap missing for never used; delta mean missing for no recent samples
spec.read_boundary: literal member indices only; no H calls, offline quality priors, lookahead, vectors returned, loops or writes
spec.score_interface: unchanged relative-gap-min, final complete-instance cost only
spec.cost: commit O(1), observe/output O(K+10), memory O(K+10), in addition to v2 sensors
